scope: control-only immutable source payload plus hard parent/child identity invariants, complete child key in initial hash and verified operation transitions

proposed_work_order.fixed_operation_semantics: only editable state changes and exactly one existing fault.mode changes; immutable source and all identities never change
proposed_work_order.future_mapping: T1 only, fresh same-candidate source-backed lossless mapping into CandidateStatePackageV5Next

hard_identity_invariants: parent binding candidate equals key candidate; declaration ref equals payload parent ref; declaration hash equals key/payload parent hash; binding hash recomputes exactly
payload ref candidate/parent binding/parent ref/hash/child contract/ref hash/source record ref/source content hash exactly equal payload fields
source record ref URI/version/hash byte-matches source record own record_uri/record_version/source_record_hash
payload source_uri/version byte-match source record record_uri/version
child contract identity hash equals H(canonical(actual child_contract_ref))

initial_hash_identity.rule: initial_state_hash formula explicitly includes all four child-key fields before status/source/absence/status fields
initial_hash_identity.purpose: different candidate, parent, child kind or child ID cannot share an initial hash merely because source bodies match

operation_transition_hard_invariants.reject: wrong previous/last/result hash, reordered/omitted/duplicated history, duplicate operation ID/hash or mismatched key/source refs -> fail_closed and old state bytes unchanged

five_hash_layers: source_record_hash over own record URI/version and all four complete slots; downstream hashes excluded
source_content_hash over key, complete parent binding/ref/hash, actual child contract ref/hash, source URI/version, complete source-record ref and body; own hash excluded
initial_state_hash over all four explicit child-key fields, status, source ref/body/hash or typed-absent marker, admission, typed physical resolution, ZERO operation and typed empty history; frozen

operation_hash over full operation identity including prior/replacement editable body hashes, fault ID, before/after mode, previous state hash and exact source-record/source-payload refs; operation/result hashes excluded

resulting_state_hash over state identity, immutable source ref, editable body, initial hashes, previous state, prior operation hashes, new operation hash and last-operation hash; no resulting hash input

canonical_failure_check.required: after bytes and digest equal before; result.state===old_state where runtime identity is meaningful; otherwise byte equality is mandatory
canonical_failure_check.applies_to: all failed transitions, including stale, forged, foreign, malformed, duplicate, reordered, non-mode, multi-fault, absent and forbidden operations

review_requirement: different Luna independently reviews R6 before implementation dispatch
